'''Willus''' was a member of the [[Believers]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Willus was a member of a group of Believers who were sent to place some transmitters on fault lines on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]], as part of a plot to release a virus on the planet. Willus attacked the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who were investigating the plot, and was defeated by them.

==Behind the scenes==
Willus appeared in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast]]''. The number of Believers that attack the Heroes of Cularin with Willus can vary with player tier of the player characters. For lower-tier players, Willus is accompanied by the Believer [[Urna]]. For middle-tier players, Willus is accompanied by Urna and [[Imber]]; and for higher-tier players, Willus is accompanied by Urna, Imber and [[Garit]].
